MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Job Description:

Better and fairer care. Always.

We are St Vincent's Health Australia, Australia's largest not-for-profit provider of health and aged care services.

Founded by The Sisters of Charity in 1857, our +30,000 healthcare superheroes operate public and private hospitals, residential aged care, community and virtual care, and outreach programs.

About the role

Be part of a busy and collaborative team providing first and second-level technical support for computer systems, software, and hardware issues, both remotely and face-to-face. Troubleshoot, monitor, and restore personal computers and devices connected to the network

Deliver high-quality client service, managing issues with integrity, compassion, and timely resolution

Work from various sites across our Hospital and Aged Care network in QLD to resolve technical incidents

Participate in the after-hours on-call roster

About you

Current Australian driver's license and reliable vehicle is a MUST Certificate IV in Information Technology Support (or equivalent experience)

Minimum 3+ years' experience in field engineering, desktop support or IT technical roles

Strong knowledge and skills in PC hardware and associated devices

Good understanding and associated skills in networking

Experience supporting AV systems, nurse call, telephony and comms room infrastructure

Working knowledge of Cisco, VoIP, DECT and Analog Phone setup and configuration

Must be able to commit to fulltime hours, including after-hours on-call requirements as detailed above

Why work at St Vincent's?

Join us on our mission to provide care to all, including the most at-risk people in our community

Discounted access to many gyms for you and your family with Fitness Passport

Access to discounted private health insurance with Medibank

Access to a salary sacrifice program (smart salary). Make a proportion of your salary tax-free!

Committed to financial support for educational development, scholarship programs, paid study leave

Sponsorship - work rights for Australia

Please note, visa sponsorship is not available for this position. For this role you must be an Australian or New Zealand citizen or have an Australia visa that grants you the work rights necessary for the role.

Pre-employment checks

Your employment is conditional upon the completion of all role-required pre-employment checks, including relevant immunisations.

Equal opportunity

We celebrate diversity & inclusion and are committed to equal employment opportunity for everyone.

How to apply

Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter highlighting how your interest, skills, and experience align with the role.

Respectfully, this role is not open to recruitment agencies.

Lead enterprise AI strategy, architecture, and delivery across transformative digital initiatives.   Your new company   Join a forward-thinking organisation undergoing a significant digital and data transformation journey. With a strong focus on innovation, emerging technologies, and data-driven decision-making, this organisation is investing in modern AI, analytics, and digital platforms to enhance business outcomes and create long-term value. You will be part of a collaborative environment where technology plays a critical role in shaping future capabilities across the enterprise.    Your new role     
 As the Technical Lead - AI, you will provide both strategic direction and hands-on leadership across enterprise AI, data, analytics, intelligent automation, and digital platform initiatives. Acting as the key link between business stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams, you will drive the design and delivery of scalable, secure, and business-aligned solutions. 
 You will lead the development of enterprise AI and data platforms, define future-state architecture, establish trusted data foundations, and guide the implementation of modern integration and automation capabilities. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will facilitate technical workshops, influence technology roadmaps, and ensure delivery outcomes align with organisational objectives. 
 In addition, you will mentor development teams, promote engineering best practices, and provide governance across solution design, cybersecurity, Responsible AI, and enterprise architecture standards. 
  What you'll need to succeed     
 To be successful in this role, you will demonstrate: 
 
 Proven experience leading complex AI, data, digital transformation, or enterprise technology programs. 
 Strong hands-on expertise in software engineering, solution architecture, and cloud-based platform delivery. 
 Experience designing and implementing AI and data solutions leveraging technologies such as AWS, Snowflake, Cortex AI, Machine Learning, Intelligent Automation, Conversational AI, and Agent-based solutions. 
 Deep understanding of enterprise data architecture, semantic modelling, canonical data structures, API and integration architecture, governance, and security frameworks. 
 Ability to define technology strategy, future-state architecture, and scalable solution roadmaps. 
 Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and business decision-makers. 
 Experience mentoring technical teams and driving high standards of delivery, operational readiness, and continuous improvement. 
 
  What you'll get in return     
 In return, you will have the opportunity to lead enterprise-scale AI and digital transformation initiatives within a progressive and innovation-focused environment. You will play a key role in shaping technology strategy, influencing architectural direction, and delivering solutions that create measurable business impact. 
 You'll benefit from working alongside experienced professionals, exposure to emerging technologies, and the ability to make a lasting contribution to the organisation's future digital capabilities. 
  What you need to do now     
 If you're interested in this role, click  'apply now'  to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now. 
 If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion on your career.  Please  click here  to apply.

## Telecommunications Technical Officer / Technologist
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Telecommunications Technical Officer or Technologist to join our team and contribute to the delivery of reliable, high-performance telecommunications infrastructure. This role is responsible for the design, installation, maintenance, and optimisation of complex communication networks and systems across a range of technologies. The ideal candidate brings solid hands-on technical experience, strong analytical capability, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. This position suits a proactive professional who is committed to maintaining the highest standards of network performance and service delivery.
## Key Responsibilities
- Install, configure, and maintain microwave, satellite, telemetry, and other radio and electromagnetic communication systems, ensuring all equipment operates to specification and within regulatory requirements.
- Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve network faults, performance issues, and equipment malfunctions in a timely and effective manner, minimising disruption to services.
- Integrate telecommunications networks with computer hardware, software platforms, operating systems, databases, and peripheral devices to ensure seamless end-to-end functionality.
- Monitor the ongoing performance of complex networks and communication systems, identifying trends, anomalies, and areas for optimisation before they impact service quality.
- Plan and support the development of customer access network infrastructure, contributing to capacity planning, design reviews, and upgrade programmes.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation including inventory logs, equipment records, asset statuses, and communication policies, procedures, and quality standards in accordance with organisational and regulatory guidelines.
- Provide clear technical advice and support to internal stakeholders, project teams, and end users on telecommunications systems, configurations, and best practices.
- Liaise with vendors, suppliers, and external service providers to coordinate procurement, installation activities, and ongoing service delivery, whilst monitoring contractual performance and obligations.
- Support the design and optimisation of network architecture, contributing technical input to projects aimed at improving reliability, scalability, and performance.
- Conduct routine inspections, preventive maintenance, and equipment testing to ensure network integrity and compliance with applicable standards.
- Assist in the development and review of technical documentation, including network diagrams, standard operating procedures, and incident reports.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams on telecommunications projects, providing technical expertise throughout the project lifecycle from scoping through to commissioning and handover.
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- A diploma, advanced diploma, or bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electronics, Information Technology, or a related field; or equivalent industry experience in lieu of formal qualifications.
- Demonstrated experience in a telecommunications technical role, with hands-on exposure to radio frequency (RF), microwave, satellite, or fixed-line communication systems.
- Solid understanding of network protocols, telecommunications standards, and systems integration principles.
- Proficiency in configuring and troubleshooting network hardware, software, and associated technologies including switches, routers, and transmission equipment.
- Experience with network monitoring tools and fault management systems, with the ability to interpret performance data and take corrective action.
- Strong documentation skills with the ability to maintain accurate records, produce technical reports, and adhere to quality and compliance standards.
- Effective communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Ability to manage competing priorities, work methodically under pressure, and deliver outcomes within agreed timeframes.
- A valid Australian driver's licence, as field-based work and site visits may be required.
- Willingness to participate in an on-call roster or undertake out-of-hours work when operational requirements demand.
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant industry certifications such as Cisco CCNA/CCNP, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent telecommunications qualifications.
- Experience working with microwave backhaul systems, fibre optic networks, or mobile network infrastructure (2G/3G/4G/5G).
- Familiarity with Australian telecommunications regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements, including those governed by the ACMA.
- Exposure to project management methodologies and experience contributing to telecommunications infrastructure projects.
- Knowledge of ITIL frameworks or experience working within a managed services or enterprise network environment.
- Postgraduate qualifications in Telecommunications, Network Engineering, or a related discipline.
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and highly skilled engineering team working on critical telecommunications infrastructure that makes a real difference to communities and businesses across Australia.
- Enjoy genuine opportunities for professional development, including access to industry training, certifications, and career progression pathways within the organisation.
- Benefit from a flexible working environment that supports work-life balance, with options for hybrid arrangements where operational requirements allow.
- Receive a competitive remuneration package with superannuation contributions, and access to additional employee benefits including wellness programmes and paid leave entitlements.
- Work on a diverse range of projects and technologies that will broaden your technical expertise and keep you at the forefront of the evolving telecommunications landscape.
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Superannuation

About Us

JBS Australia is the largest and most respected meat and food producer in Australia. We have a strong portfolio of leading and renowned beef, lamb, pork, salmon and value-added branded products, such as AMH, Swift, Primo, Murray Valley and Huon.

JBS Australia’s Northern Division operates five strategically placed processing facilities as well as five feedlots across Queensland and New South Wales, with access to an extensive network of quality cattle. Our network provides the ability to meet the specific demands of various market segments with an extensive range of grain-fed and pasture-fed products. With approximately 15,000 employees spread across our offices, processing plants and feedlots, JBS Australia exports to more than 50 countries around the world.

About the Role

An exciting opportunity is opening for a maintenance planner for our Dinmore Site, it is a full-time role and responsible for our Dinmore site Maintenance related tasks. The annual salary for this role is not less than $79,423.00 plus superannuation.

The maintenance planer is responsible for a wide range of engineering and maintenance activities associated with the operations of multiple cattle feedlots. The maintenance planner develops and implements long-term and short-term maintenance plans for all mechanical and electrical equipment to optimize feedlot safety, quality, equipment availability, and reliability outcomes. The role provides direction and guidance to the feedlot maintenance team members to ensure the safe and efficient maintenance and repair of the electrical and mechanical assets. Additionally, the role identifies and implements continuous improvement opportunities in processes, systems, and equipment, and manages nominated capital projects.

Reporting to the plant engineer, this is a leadership position within the maintenance team. The position is hands-on, requires extensive maintenance and equipment knowledge, provides equipment solutions using sound maintenance principles, and requires the ability to lead and develop maintenance crew team members.

 Responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

· Facilitate maintenance to ensure production requirements are met.

· Ensure all requested and scheduled tasks are investigated, planned, executed, completed, and closed out on time and on budget.

· Prepare and order necessary spare parts and materials for planned tasks.

· Monitor spare parts holdings and the condition of critical spares.

· Develop and maintain the sap pm equipment register (functional locations).

· Monitor maintenance employee timesheets and follow up on any comments and recommendations.

· Plan, schedule, and monitor completion of maintenance work orders.

· Program and ensure all statutory requirements are met.

· Plan, schedule, and coordinate all major repair tasks in conjunction with the feedlot engineer.

· Ensure all documentation and schematics are securely retained, updated, and maintained as required.

· Coordinate teams of trades and non-trades personnel and external contractors.

· Ensure company procedures are supported and adhered to, i.e., permits to work, hot work permits, isolation and locking out, risk assessments, live work procedures, incident reporting, etc.

· Support, coordinate, and control ongoing maintenance and capital works planning and coordination functions for all areas of the feedlot.

· Facilitate and develop the processes required to analyze downtime.

· Produce actions to fix root cause and prevent failures from reoccurring.

· Development of effective contractor management systems including performance auditing.

· Assist in the delivery of projects and maintenance services.

· Implement minor projects and commissioning.

· Resolve issues and improve the existing and future feedlot systems.

· Develop systems and practices to maximize the benefit of the sap pm maintenance management system.

· Communicate with operations personnel on maintenance issues.

· Provide in-house training to other staff on the planning and scheduling systems.

· Organize and schedule maintenance training as required.

· Provide information for maintenance management reporting.

· Dealing with a multitude of tasks and demands at the one time with limited resources.

· Dealing with a wide range of people with varying levels of skills.

· Identifying and implementing solutions to quickly address feedlot breakdowns.

About you:

· A thorough understanding of work planning and scheduling procedures using sap pm.

· A thorough understanding of maintenance work management practices.

· Advanced electrical or mechanical trade or post-trade qualifications and experience.

· Experience in maintenance in a feedlot environment, desired but not essential.

· Proven ability to lead, manage, and motivate employees.

· The ability to lead and motivate people to continuously improve.

· Experience gained from a large heavy industrial organization.

· Extensive computer skills.

· Well-developed communication and interpersonal skills.

· Effective problem-solving capacity.

· Sound knowledge of OH&S regulations.

The ad is valid for 28 days.
